context: Apply sanitize_platform_options at the three sites. Watch for behavior tests that pin exact platform.config contents; redaction should only change values whose keys match the secret list, so legitimate fixtures stay stable.
description: Found 2026-07-31 during the credential-egress review. Three internal-export paths copy platform configuration without any secret filtering: (1) schema.py:526 platform['config'] = _extract_platform_config(result.platform_info) - the extractor (schema.py:1650-1685) recursively flattens platform_info['configuration'] with only a name/version exclusion list; (2) the raw_config fallbacks schema.py:538 and builder.py:1093 use that unsanitized config whenever no adapter-produced platform_raw_config exists (e.g. DataFrame adapters); (3) database.py:355-412 stores full raw platform_info as metadata_json in ~/.benchbox/results.db. Driven proof: _extract_platform_config({'configuration':{'password':'PW-SENTINEL'}}) returns the sentinel verbatim. Severity LOW because a same-day sentinel sweep of every constructible registered adapter showed get_platform_info() puts no credential values into platform_info today - the paths are safe by adapter convention only, and one adapter regression turns them into a live leak. Fix: run these extractions through sanitize_platform_options (or is_secret_option_key filtering) so the safety is enforced, not conventional.

preserves.behavior: Non-secret platform.config keys keep their real values (downstream analysis depends on them)
results.db schema unchanged - only the stored payload is filtered
